evidence: A former Kindle user says KCC was great; a second commenter highlights filesize optimization, black-level correction, spread joining, and color-e-ink rainbow removal.

evidence_sources.author: maeln
evidence_sources.excerpt: I used to use KCC when I had a Kindle and it was great !

evidence_sources.author: seam_carver
evidence_sources.excerpt: KCC best features: 1) filesize optimization. Think 600 to 100 mb after optimization per volume depending on source and settings. Does it by downscaling and dithering from 256 to 16 shades of gray (e.g. 8 bit to 4 bit) 2) black level correction. You need pure blacks in eink. Dark gray looks ok on paper and normal screens but not eink. Does it with histogram manipulation 3) semi automatic 2 page spread joining. spreads can be autorotated or not. 4) rainbow removal on kaleido 3 color eink with 2D discrete Fourier transform

source_story_title: Show HN: Using 2D DFT, dithering, etc. to maximize eInk manga image quality
